title: Think: if-then rules
about: How a robot decides what to do, why the order of its rules matters, and your Bot Arena brain.

html: A robot's brain can be a list of rules: IF something is true, THEN do something.
A robot vacuum might have rules like these:

• IF the bumper is pressed THEN turn around
  • IF the cliff sensor sees a drop THEN back up
  • IF the battery is low THEN drive to the charger
The IF part checks a sensor: that's Sense. Picking which rule to follow is Think. The THEN part runs the motors: that's Act.
Our vacuum checks its rules from the top, every turn. The first rule that's true wins, and it skips the rest. Look what happens when the same two rules swap places:

Turns at walls ✓
  1. IF a wall is ahead THEN turn right
  2. IF always THEN drive forward

Bumps forever ✗
  1. IF always THEN drive forward
  2. IF a wall is ahead THEN turn right

"IF always" is true every turn, so rule 2 never gets a chance.
Put the special cases first and the "always" rule last.
Pick the Custom brain in Bot Arena and you write its rules, up to 3. Every turn it checks them from the top, just like the vacuum:

• IF the enemy's shield is up THEN power attack
  • IF my hit chance is below 40% THEN aim first
  • IF my health is below 50 THEN shield
If no rule fits, it attacks. The battle log shows which rule ran each turn, so you can watch your program work.
Ready to test your rules? The Brain Challenges in Practice Mode have five boss robots, and each one needs a different idea.

steps.q: A vacuum's rules are: 1. IF stairs are ahead THEN turn right. 2. IF always THEN drive forward. Stairs are ahead. What does it do?
steps.explain: Rule 1 is true, so it turns right and skips rule 2. Only one rule runs each turn.

steps.q: Which list of rules has a mistake?
options: 1. IF a wall is ahead THEN turn right. 2. IF always THEN drive forward.
1. IF always THEN drive forward. 2. IF a wall is ahead THEN turn right.
steps.explain: IF always is true every turn, so in the second list the wall rule never runs.

steps.q: Your Bot Arena rules are: 1. IF my hit chance is below 40% THEN aim first. 2. IF always THEN power attack. This turn your hit chance is 82%. What does your robot do?
steps.explain: 82% isn't below 40%, so rule 1 is skipped. Rule 2 is always true, so it power attacks.

steps.q: In a rule, which part is the robot's Sense step?
steps.explain: The IF part checks what the robot senses. Picking the rule is Think, and the THEN part is Act.
